metadata.title: Knot Floer complexes of generalized L-space knots
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study height 4 knots, which generalize L-space knots and almost L-space knots studied by Ozsváth--Szabó, Baldwin--Sivek, and Binns. A knot $K\subset S^3$ is called a height $m$ knot if $\operatorname{rank} \widehat{HF}(S^3_n(K))-n=m$ for all integers $n\geq 2g(K)-1$, where $\widehat{HF}$ is the hat version of Heegaard Floer homology introduced by Ozsváth--Szabó. In particular, height 0 and height 2 knots are exactly L-space knots and almost L-space knots, respectively. We prove that the knot Floer complex $CFK^\infty(S^3,K)$ of a height 4 knot $K$ admits a basis that is horizontally and vertically simplified--an hv-basis for short. Moreover, we show that under such an hv-basis, the horizontal and vertical differentials fall into six cases, generalizing the results for L-space knots and almost L-space knots. The hv-basis of the knot Floer complex of $K$ can determine, via an explicit algorithm, the immersed curve of Hanselman-Rasmussen-Watson for the knot complement of $K$. Consequently, our results facilitate further exploration of computations of $\widehat{HF}$ for the gluing of two height 4 knot complements.
metadata.comment: 89 pages, 122 figures, 26 tables. Most figures depict subquotient complexes by displaying their generators and differentials

analysis.progressType: 结 Floer 复形的结构分类
analysis.workSummary: 对满足所有整数 n≥2g(K)−1 时 rank ĤF(S³_n(K))−n=4 的高度 4 结，证明其 CFK∞ 存在同时水平、竖直简化的 hv 基。作者将该基下的水平和竖直微分分成六种情形，并给出从 hv 基求结补空间 Hanselman–Rasmussen–Watson 浸入曲线的显式算法。
techniques: Heegaard Floer 大手术秩条件
结 Floer 复形 hv 基
analysis.breakthrough: 把 L-space 结与 almost L-space 结的既有结构描述推进到高度 4，为两个此类结补空间拼接后的 ĤF 计算提供工具。
analysis.limitations: 六种情形描述的是所述基下的水平、竖直微分；摘要没有声称分类所有高度 4 结，也没有直接给出所有拼接的同调结果。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
